title: Recognition of Cash Pickup Sending in Bank Deposit Late-Delivery Refunds
content:
Pickup points reward a customer's Cash Pickup sending when a Bank Deposit transfer of theirs is owed a late-delivery refund. Each pickup point is one percentage point added to the late-delivery refund share of that Bank Deposit transfer.

## Records read

The customer's Cash Pickup payouts: the entries on the ledgers of the customer's Cash Pickup transfers recording that the payout location handed the cash to the recipient, each with its payout date and its amount in US dollars. Two figures are taken from them: how many such payouts there were in the last twelve months, and their dollar total. A Cash Pickup payout counts when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its payout date from the handling date.

## Schedule

1. A customer whose Cash Pickup payouts in the last twelve months number at least 5 **and** total at least 1800 US dollars earns **15** pickup points.
2. A customer who does not meet both of those, but whose Cash Pickup payouts in the last twelve months number at least 3 **or** total at least 1000 US dollars, earns **8** pickup points.
3. Any other customer earns no pickup points.

## Combinations

| Payouts in the last twelve months | Dollar total | Pickup points |
|---|---|---|
| 5 or more | 1800 or more | 15 |
| 5 or more | below 1800 | 8 (at least 3 payouts) |
| 3 or 4 | any amount | 8 |
| fewer than 3 | 1000 or more | 8 |
| fewer than 3 | below 1000 | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- 6 payouts totalling 1700.00: not both high figures (the total is below 1800), but at least 3 payouts, so 8 points.
- 5 payouts totalling exactly 1800.00: both high figures met, so 15 points.
- 2 payouts totalling 1200.00: the total reaches 1000, so 8 points.
- 2 payouts totalling 999.99: neither mid figure met, so no pickup points.

**Twelve-month count (hypothetical dates).** Handling on 15 October 2026: a payout dated 16 October 2025 is 11 whole calendar months earlier and counts; a payout dated 15 October 2025 is 12 whole calendar months earlier and does not count.
